contentEn:
If your Vancouver home still runs an aging gas furnace or window AC unit, 2026 is the year to seriously consider a heat pump. Modern heat pumps cut heating bills by 40-60% compared to gas, qualify for up to $11,000 in combined rebates, and eliminate the carbon-tax penalty on every heating day. Reno Stars has installed ducted and ductless heat pump systems across Richmond, Burnaby, Vancouver and Surrey - here is a plain-English breakdown of what it actually costs and what the rebates actually cover.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

What a Heat Pump Costs in Metro Vancouver in 2026

Heat pump prices in the Vancouver area span a wide range depending on system type, home size and whether you are retrofitting an existing ducted system or starting fresh. All prices below are fully installed, including labour, permits and any required electrical upgrades.

System TypeInstalled Cost (CAD)Best For
Ductless single-zone (3/4 ton)$4,500 - $7,500One room or open plan space
Ductless multi-split (2-3 zones)$8,000 - $15,0002-3 rooms, no existing ducts
Ductless multi-split (4+ zones)$14,000 - $22,000Whole-floor or whole-house, no ducts
Ducted central (replace gas furnace)$12,000 - $25,000+Whole house, existing ductwork
Cold-climate ducted + backup heat$18,000 - $35,000+Whole house, premium tier

BC and Federal Rebates: Up to $11,000 Combined

Three separate rebate programs can stack on top of each other - and Reno Stars handles the application paperwork on your behalf, including the pre- and post-home energy audit if it changes your eligibility tier.

  • BC Hydro heat pump rebate: up to $3,000
  • Federal Greener Homes Grant: up to $5,000
  • BC Hydro income-qualified low-income top-up: additional $3,000
  • Combined potential rebate: up to $11,000

Eligibility for the income-qualified top-up depends on your home energy audit results and household income. The federal Greener Homes Grant applies to any owner-occupied primary residence with an eligible heat pump installed by a licensed contractor. Reno Stars is a licensed contractor registered with both programs.

How Noisy Is a Heat Pump?

Outdoor units produce 50-62 dB - similar to a refrigerator or a quiet conversation at home. City of Vancouver noise bylaws require outdoor units to stay below 60 dB measured at the property line. Reno Stars positions all outdoor units to respect required setbacks, and recommends quieter models - such as the Mitsubishi MUZ-FH series or Daikin FTXM series - for tight urban lots in Richmond, Vancouver and Burnaby where neighbouring properties are close.

Heat Pump vs. Gas Furnace: Annual Operating Cost Comparison

Heating SystemAnnual Operating Cost (Vancouver, 2026)
Gas furnace (80% efficiency)$1,800 - $2,400
Gas furnace (96% efficiency)$1,400 - $1,900
Heat pump (COP 3.0, standard)$900 - $1,400
Cold-climate heat pump (COP 3.5+)$700 - $1,100

With BC Hydro's existing tiered rates (Step 1: $0.099/kWh) and federal carbon pricing at $80/tonne on gas in 2026, the payback window for a heat pump upgrade has shortened to 6-10 years on average for most Metro Vancouver homes. Cold-climate heat pumps maintain full heating capacity down to -25C - well below any temperature Vancouver experiences - making backup heat rarely necessary.

Three Common Vancouver Heat Pump Scenarios

1. Adding AC to a heat-only home. Roughly 70% of pre-2010 Vancouver single-family homes have no cooling system. A 3-zone ductless mini-split adds both air conditioning and supplemental heat for $10,000-$14,000 installed. This is the most common Reno Stars heat pump installation in older Vancouver and Richmond homes.

2. Replacing a 20+ year gas furnace. Federal carbon pricing makes replacing an aging gas furnace the right financial call now. A heat pump central system runs $14,000-$22,000 installed; combined BC Hydro and federal rebates can offset $7,000-$11,000 of that cost.

3. Heat pump + Critical Load Panel + EV charger bundle. If your electrical panel needs upgrading anyway - a heat pump typically requires a 30-amp dedicated circuit and an EV charger needs 40-amp - bundling everything in one electrician visit is the most cost-efficient path. Combined cost typically $22,000-$35,000. Reno Stars handles both the heat pump installation and the panel upgrade in a single project.

See also: Toy Store renovation in Metrotown, Burnaby and Dental Clinic renovation in Burnaby for examples of completed Reno Stars commercial and residential projects.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

FAQ: Heat Pump Installation in Vancouver

Will a heat pump keep my Vancouver home warm enough in winter?

Yes. Cold-climate heat pumps (Mitsubishi Hyper Heat, Daikin Fit, Bosch IDS) operate efficiently down to -25C. Metro Vancouver's average January low is around 1-3C, and the city has never recorded a temperature below -10C in the past decade. We size each system based on a heat loss calculation for your specific home, not just square footage, and add backup heat only for the coldest 5-10 days per year if needed.

Can I keep my gas furnace as backup heat?

Yes - this is called a dual-fuel or hybrid setup. The heat pump runs as the primary heat source year-round, and the existing gas furnace supplements only on the coldest days. Dual-fuel adds slightly to upfront cost but eliminates the carbon-tax penalty on most heating days while keeping a gas backup for the rare extreme cold snap.

What maintenance does a heat pump require?

Clean or replace air filters every 1-3 months - the single most important maintenance step. Annual professional servicing ($150-$250) checks refrigerant levels, cleans coil surfaces and verifies electrical connections. With regular maintenance a heat pump lasts 15-20 years, compared to 12-15 years for a typical gas furnace.

Does Reno Stars handle the rebate applications?

Yes - we complete the BC Hydro heat pump rebate application and the federal Greener Homes Grant application on your behalf, including the required pre- and post-installation home energy audits that determine eligibility tiers. You receive the rebate as a credit on your final invoice.

How long does a heat pump installation take?

A single-zone ductless install typically takes 1-2 days. A multi-zone or ducted central system takes 3-7 days depending on whether new ductwork or electrical panel upgrades are required. All work is completed by Reno Stars licensed tradespeople.
contentZh:
如果您的温哥华房屋仍在使用老旧燃气炉或窗式空调，2026年是认真考虑安装热泵的时机。现代热泵的供暖费用比燃气低40%至60%，有资格获得高达$11,000的组合补贴，还能消除每个供暖日的碳税惩罚。Reno Stars已在列治文、本拿比、温哥华和素里安装了管道和无管道热泵系统——以下是实际成本和补贴覆盖范围的详细分解。

2026年大温哥华热泵安装费用

温哥华地区热泵价格因系统类型、房屋面积以及是改造现有管道系统还是全新安装而差异很大。以下价格均为全包价格，包括人工、许可证和任何所需的电气升级。

系统类型安装费用（加元）适用房屋
无管道单区（3/4吨）$4,500 - $7,500单房或开放空间
无管道多区（2-3区）$8,000 - $15,0002-3个房间，无现有管道
无管道多区（4区以上）$14,000 - $22,000整层或整屋，无管道
管道中央系统（更换燃气炉）$12,000 - $25,000+全屋，现有管道
耐寒管道系统+备用供暖$18,000 - $35,000+全屋，高端配置

BC省和联邦补贴：最高可叠加$11,000

三个独立的补贴计划可以叠加申请——Reno Stars代表您处理所有申请文书工作，包括前后的家庭能源评估（可能影响您的资格等级）。

  • BC Hydro热泵补贴：最高$3,000
  • 联邦绿色家居补助：最高$5,000
  • BC Hydro低收入资格补充：额外$3,000
  • 可叠加最高补贴：$11,000

低收入补充补贴的资格取决于您家庭的能源评估结果和收入水平。联邦绿色家居补助适用于任何由持牌承包商安装符合条件热泵的自住主要住宅。Reno Stars是两个计划的注册承包商。

热泵有多吵？

室外机产生50-62分贝——与冰箱或安静的对话相当。温哥华市噪音条例要求室外机在产权线测量时保持在60分贝以下。Reno Stars将所有室外机放置在符合要求的位置，对于列治文、温哥华和本拿比等城市用地紧张的项目，推荐使用更安静的型号（如Mitsubishi MUZ-FH系列或Daikin FTXM系列）。

热泵与燃气炉：年度运营成本对比

供暖系统年度运营成本（温哥华，2026年）
燃气炉（80%效率）$1,800 - $2,400
燃气炉（96%效率）$1,400 - $1,900
热泵（COP 3.0，标准）$900 - $1,400
耐寒热泵（COP 3.5+）$700 - $1,100

以BC Hydro现行阶梯电价（第一阶梯：$0.099/kWh）和2026年每吨$80的联邦碳税计算，对于大多数大温哥华房屋来说，热泵升级的回本周期已缩短至6至10年。耐寒热泵在零下25C的环境下仍能保持全供暖能力——远低于温哥华经历的任何温度，因此备用供暖很少需要启用。

三个常见温哥华热泵安装场景

1. 为仅供暖房屋添加制冷。约70%的2010年前温哥华独立屋没有制冷系统。3区无管道迷你分体式系统可同时增加空调和辅助供暖，安装费用$10,000至$14,000。这是Reno Stars在温哥华和列治文老旧房屋中最常见的热泵安装项目。

2. 更换20年以上的燃气炉。联邦碳税政策使更换老旧燃气炉成为明智的财务决策。热泵中央系统安装费用$14,000至$22,000；BC Hydro和联邦补贴合计可抵消$7,000至$11,000。

3. 热泵+关键负载电箱+电动汽车充电器组合安装。如果您的配电箱需要升级——热泵通常需要30安培专用电路，电动汽车充电器需要40安培——将所有项目合并一次电工上门是最具成本效益的方式，总费用通常$22,000至$35,000。Reno Stars在单个项目中同时处理热泵安装和电箱升级。

另见：本拿比Metrotown商铺装修和本拿比牙科诊所装修，了解更多Reno Stars已完成的项目案例。

常见问题：温哥华热泵安装

热泵能在温哥华的冬天保持房屋足够温暖吗？

可以。耐寒热泵（Mitsubishi Hyper Heat、Daikin Fit、Bosch IDS）在零下25C的环境下仍能高效运行。温哥华一月的平均低温约为1-3C，过去十年从未记录过低于零下10C的温度。我们根据您特定房屋的热损失计算（而非仅按平方英尺）来确定每套系统的规格，只有在最冷的5-10天才会需要备用供暖。

可以保留燃气炉作为备用供暖吗？

可以——这称为双燃料或混合设置。热泵全年作为主要供暖运行，现有燃气炉仅在最冷的日子补充供暖。双燃料略微增加前期成本，但消除了大多数供暖日的碳税惩罚，同时在罕见的极端寒冷时期保留燃气备用。

热泵需要什么维护？

每1-3个月清洁或更换空气过滤器——这是最重要的维护步骤。年度专业维护服务（$150-$250）检查制冷剂水平、清洁线圈表面并验证电气连接。定期维护下，热泵使用寿命为15-20年，而典型燃气炉为12-15年。
